title: Instance identity reachable with cross-service access (confused-deputy style)
impact: A reachable instance identity with broad downstream access can enable a confused-deputy or privilege-escalation chain across cloud services.
remediation: Least-privilege the instance role; enforce IMDSv2/hop-limit 1; scope resource access.
description: A reachable cloud instance identity co-occurs with broad resource access; review the cross-service permission chain.
